verdict.rationale: Fastmail's JMAP API supports real-time push via EventSource (SSE) and WebPush, letting a client subscribe to mailbox state changes without polling, which materially satisfies the 'subscribe to events' need for agentic workflows. However, this is not a classic webhook (arbitrary HTTP POST callback URL registration) — WebPush requires a compatible push service/endpoint model rather than a simple webhook subscription, and no docs describe a dedicated webhook API or callback registration mechanism. Missing for 10: explicit webhook (POST-to-URL) subscription API/docs, examples of registering arbitrary callback endpoints, and independent confirmation of push reliability for agent use cases.
